diagnosis: Customer reports sustained 429s for a ~20-minute nightly batch at ~5,400 rpm, consistent with hitting the plan ceiling rather than a burst. Any increase above the plan ceiling requires a capacity review, so this is routed to a specialist. No limits or approvals are promised in the reply.
reply: Thanks for including the peak sustained rate and the measurement window - that's exactly what a capacity review needs. Sustained 429s across the whole 20-minute window typically indicate you're reaching your plan ceiling rather than a temporary burst (see kb-0014). In the meantime, your client should honour the Retry-After header returned with each 429, using jitter, to smooth out the batch (kb-0014). Because increases above the plan ceiling require a capacity review (kb-0004), I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
